question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping in Section 22 13 16 due to supplier lead times.
proposed_solution: Use an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request with no cost impact, it is routed to the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer as the design professional of record for the plumbing discipline.
